card.name: The after evaluate/confirm in clinical instructions
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after a verb like confirm, evaluate, or observation of, in label instructions about checking a patient or diagnosis.

modes.label: Confirm the diagnosis
modes.description: "the" after "confirm" when adrenal insufficiency is suspected.
modes.example: If adrenal insufficiency is suspected, confirm<< the>> diagnosis with diagnostic testing as soon as possible

modes.label: Evaluate the patient
modes.description: "the" after "evaluate" or "observation of" before the word patient.
modes.example: If concomitant use is warranted, frequently evaluate<< the>> patient, particularly during treatment initiation and dose
